race.comment: SENSATIONAL SECRET (10) did not let down as expected last start, and had been freshened up since that modest effort. He form prior was good, and she can make amends in this. MOTOSCAFO (6) has recently been bought out of Sydney, and his last run was just under a month ago at Newcastle. A change of scenery can work wonders, so keep an eye the market moves. COSMIC SHOWER (3) was an overdue maiden winner here on the Parks track here 4 weeks ago. Noel Callow sticks with her, and so do we. MEG'S MAGIC (5) is a consistent mare still on the up with her fitness, and she must be kept safe in all top 4 combos.
